resources.string: An interactive tutorial explains the main controls, with a welcome shown only on the first launch.
Choose calendar-day paths (0–24) or the next 24 hours (+24h). Daily path, capture labels and exported tables follow the same interval.
Tap empty sky to show or hide the reticle and its information bubbles. Capture labels keep their own setting.
Selected points can show their antipodal directions. Tap the Antipodes button to show or hide them; hold it to deselect all points.
Visible antipodes are included in photos, panoramas and their exported tables. Daily path and its exports retain only the original points.
Current objects use one border matching the orbit colour above or below the horizon. Selected current positions have a blue or cyan border.
